<h1 id="lab-hero-title">Understanding ecosystems in a changing world</h1>
<p class="lab-intro">We study how changing land use and climate affect ecosystem structure, functions, and services. </p>

<section class="lab-section alt" aria-labelledby="themes-title">
<div class="lab-eyebrow">What we study</div>
<h2 id="themes-title">Research across scales</h2>
<p class="section-intro">We integrates ecological observations with statistical, machine learning, and process-based models to understand how biological mechanisms interact with environmental heterogeneity, disturbance, and scale.</p>
<div class="lab-grid">
<div class="lab-card"><h3>Coupled Human and Natural Systems</h3><p>Investigating the dynamic interactions and feedbacks between human activities and natural ecosystems</p><a href="Projects.html">Explore research →</a></div>
<div class="lab-card"><h3>Biodiversity Conservation</h3><p>Understanding how land use and environmental disturbances influence biodiversity while developing innovative tools and approaches to assess and monitor biodiversity.</p><a href="Projects.html">Explore research →</a></div>
<div class="lab-card"><h3>Sustainable landscapes</h3><p>Connecting ecological knowledge with agriculture, ecosystem services, and long-term landscape sustainability.</p><a href="Projects.html">Explore research →</a></div>
</div>
</section>
